description: Every test runner in scripts/ (test-*, verify-*, smoke-test), its feature area and when it runs. test-source-contracts.ps1 (its build-plan case) fails if this list and scripts/ disagree. Suites run case scripts from scripts/cases, which are not listed. Tiers: core runs in every develop.ps1 Test/BuildAndTest; release runs from release-check.ps1; extended runs with develop.ps1 -Action ExtendedTest (weekly and before every release) with -BuildPath plus any extraArgs, and that action also reruns each core suite that has extendedArgs with those arguments; manual needs other inputs (see note); helper is called by other scripts; pending fails today and is not run (see note).

runners.name: test-workspace-startup
runners.note: Extended adds normal startup; populated demo case needs -DemoPath, otherwise SKIP.

runners.name: test-workspace-migration
runners.note: Release migration matrix and upgrade; -Cases selects focused cases. Manual persistence needs -LegacyTemplate (a schema-27 blank); audit needs -FixtureMapPath; messages need -DemoPath; directory transfer needs -SourcePath.

runners.name: test-workspace-read-performance
runners.note: The test-batched-reads case (baseline/candidate read equivalence and timings) also runs when -BaselinePath names an earlier build. Other cases run with -BuildPath.

runners.name: test-import-engine
runners.note: Extended: bulk and engine import. -Tier release: engine verification; optional -SourcePath, -InstallSource, -CommitFaults.

runners.name: test-contributor-context
runners.note: Shared contributor-selection helper loaded by other runners.

runners.name: test-directory-management
runners.note: Core: merge. Extended adds directory cases; data comparison needs -SourcePath -CandidatePath. Release: -Tier release -BlankPath -DemoPath [-CurrentFixturesOnly].

runners.name: test-pdf-reading
runners.note: Local PDF needs -LocalFixturePath; expanded fixtures are generated when absent.

runners.name: test-work-review
runners.note: Core: workflows. Extended adds major/UI, work queues and wizard state; test-major LegacyPath behavior is unchanged.

runners.name: test-navfit-exchange
runners.note: Field coverage runs only with -VerifyFieldCoverage; optional -OutputPath.

runners.name: test-pdf-fixtures
runners.note: Dot-sourced by PDF runners to generate synthetic PDF fixtures (needs the .venv with pikepdf).

runners.name: test-report-validation
runners.note: Policy verification needs explicit -InstructionPath; optional -InstructionTextPath is passed through, otherwise its existing default applies.

runners.name: test-field-defaults
runners.note: Immediate-defaults verification needs -BlankPath -DemoPath, otherwise SKIP. Historical receipt assertions remain unchanged.

runners.name: verify-built-application
runners.note: Structural verifier called by build.ps1 and verify-build-artifact.
